title: Jangan pandang belakang congkak. 2
summary:
"Setelah berjaya menewaskan Mustika dan memulihkan Punai dan Asmat dalam JPBC yang lalu, Pak Mor terus berusaha untuk memperhebatkan ilmu yang ada padanya. Pada suatu hari, ketika dia sedang membaca jampi menteranya, tiba-tiba tubuh Pak Mor kejang dan serentak dengan itu satu
gumpalan asap keluar dari tubuh Pak Mor dan dari asap  itu muncul Mustika. Keadaan ini membuktikan bahawa Pak Mor dan Mustika sebenarnya mempunyai hubungan dan berpakat untuk
mengambil kesemua harta dan saka-saka Pak Sudir setelah kematiannya. Tujuan mereka mengambil kesemua saka-saka Pak Sudir, adalah untuk kekal muda selama-lamanya. Namun yang demikian, Punai dan Asmat cuba untuk menggagalkan rancangan mereka. Situasi ini memaksa Pak Mor dan Mustika bertekad untuk menghapuskan Punai dan Asmat. Usaha untuk menghapuskan Punai dan Asmat sentiasa menemui jalan buntu. Mereka bijak menghalang diri mereka dari kawalan Pak Mor dan Mustika. Pada satu hari, mereka telah berjumpa dengan seorang bomoh yang dikatakan mampu membantu mereka. Wak Ketari mempunyai ilmu kebomohan dan bersetuju untuk mengajar mereka.
Tidak mudah untuk mempelajari ilmu dari Wak Ketari kerana dia turut mengenakan beberapa syarat serta peraturan untuk dipatuhi. Punai dan Asmat menghadapi berbagai masalah semasa belajar kerana Wak Ketari seorang yang tegas dan garang. Sebelum mereka lulus, mereka dikehendaki menjalani satu ujian di mana mereka dikehendaki menangkap hantu. Walaupun pada mulanya mereka keberatan menurut tetapi kemunculan Seha iaitu anak tunggal Wak Ketari mengubah pendirian mereka serta merta. Dalam pada yang sama, Pak Mor dan Mustika terus berusaha menjejaki
mereka bagi misi menghapuskan kewujudan Punai dan Asmat. Adakah Punai dan Asmat berjaya dalam ujian yang diberikan oleh Wak Ketari? Bagaimana pula dengan usaha yang dilakukan oleh Pak Mor dan Mustika bagi menghapuskan Punai dan Asmat. "

title: The Elephant in the room : how relationships make or break the success of leaders and organizations
author: Smith, Diana McLain, 1950-
summary: "A systematic look at how relationships determine the success of leaders and their enterprises, along with tools to help strengthen and change them. Since time immemorial, relationships have determined the fate of leaders. But today they are more critical to success than ever. No longer can leaders count on long time horizons or sloppy competition to make up for the inefficiencies that poor relationships create. Leaders must make decisions and take actions quickly and well with others, even those with whom they share very little, perhaps not even a time zone. This new world puts relationships at the center of what leaders must understand and master to succeed. Uses in-depth observational studies and clinical research to explore how relationships at the top of organizations work, develop, and change. Shows how to understand, strengthen, and transform these relationships, so they can withstand the most intense pressures and conflicts."--

summary: "While the provision in Children's and Young People's Services endures much change and turbulence, the calling for well qualified and critically reflective practitioners remains ever present. This innovative and accessible core textbook explores key themes, ideas, concepts and topics that are central to practitioners working across the 0-19 sector. It aims to help students develop the professional knowledge, practical skills and core values they need to work effectively with children and young people.Clearly divided into four sections; the practitioner, the learner, the workplace and the community, the book covers a broad range of issues including:The different roles and responsibilities of the workforce Multi-agency working and its challenges Working with parents, carers and the community Supporting children with additional needs and meeting the needs of gifted learners Work-based reflective practice Language learning and communication At each stage the book facilitates opportunities for personal and professional reflection, discussion, debate and action through case studies, activities, reflective tasks, areas for further consideration, and annotated further readings. The text also features a glossary of terms and links to practice standards.Empowering the Children's and Young People's Workforce seeks to empower the reader by supporting their initial and continuing professional development, enabling them to positively influence provision for children and young people. It will be essential reading for anyone training to work in this sector"--
